findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a`
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss` line 291, `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the diff inverted the lightness values and changed the light-theme branch to `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` and the dark-theme branch to `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)`. This makes the author username link in embedded posts much lighter and lower-contrast than before (and invert-wise darker in dark themes) instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.custom-message-length` on mobile
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss` line 102, `.custom-message-length` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, swapping the 70% and 30% lightness arguments. In contrast, the same selector in `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/modal.scss` line 94 was updated to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. This makes the character count hint much darker on mobile light themes and much lighter on mobile dark themes than intended.

findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.group-member-info .name` on desktop
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss` line 522, `.user-stream .group-member-info .name` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` (probably copy-pasted from `.title` right below it). This removes the visual distinction between `.name` (previously 30% lightness) and `.title` (50% lightness); it should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.group-member-info .name` on mobile
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss` line 497, `.user-stream .group-member-info .name` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, losing the darker emphasis on `.name` relative to `.title`. To preserve the existing 30% lightness on light themes and its complement on dark themes, this should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.topic-map h3` on mobile
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss` line 182, `.topic-map h3` was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, making `h3` the same lightness as `h4` below it and inconsistent with `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss` line 321 (which uses `20%` and `80%`). It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.
